Good questions.

Can I compare equipment before deciding?

Use the catalogue to build a shortlist, then ask the store which options can be compared in person.

Is the selection personalised online?

This page helps you prepare questions. It does not perform a fitting or make an automated equipment recommendation.

What should I bring for a comparison?

Bring your current kit, typical playing format and a preferred budget. Note what feels comfortable and what you would like to change.
